changes: Repair Program admin UI: new 'Repair Program' tab in AdminDashboard with Pricing Catalog (editable rate/min/active per in-house item) and Vendor Directory (CRUD for licensed-trade vendor contacts)
Wires the already-built /api/admin/repair-pricing and /api/admin/repair-vendors endpoints to a UI for the first time
No backend/route changes in this release — repairConsult.ts routes were already live in v20.8.0
__bundleNotes: No removed code in this release, so no must-not-contain strings. Pricing rate/min values are server-provided at runtime, not bundle string literals — verified via mathChecks below instead.

mathChecks.name: repair-pricing returns both in_house and vendor category items
repair-pricing in_house items all carry a positive default_rate or min_charge
repair-pricing vendor items carry no pricing authority (rate is 0)
repair-vendors endpoint returns an array (empty directory is valid)
